rows.q: How do I know my pastry doesn't contain eggs in it?
rows.answer: A green dot means the item is vegetarian, which means it contains no meat, fish, or egg, though vegetarian items may contain dairy [1]. Additionally, restaurants tag each menu item with major allergens like egg, which OrderPal checks during onboarding and every 6 months, though they cannot guarantee complete accuracy [2]. If you have a severe allergy, you should add a note in the cooking instructions and call the restaurant before preparation begins [2].

rows.q: can I have an estimate of how much amount will I get refunded
rows.answer: The refund amount depends on the issue: missing items qualify for a refund of those items only [1], wrong items get a full refund for that item [1], quality issues are capped at the value of the affected items [1], and if an order never arrived, you get a full refund including delivery fee and taxes [1]. Free cancellations within 60 seconds give a full refund [2], and cancellations by the restaurant or OrderPal give a full refund plus a ₹50 OrderPal Wallet credit [3].

rows.q: how is the estimated delivery time calculated
